_drift_guard: server/test/cards/_spec_drift.test.js asserts the actions / conditions / expression_ops / filter_spec / trigger_events here match the engine source. If you add an engine primitive, update this file or that test fails.

card_script_schema._comment: Top-level shape of a card_scripts.json entry. All fields except card_id are optional.

onPlay.notes: fires on the OnPlay event for this card

onCall.notes: fires on the OnCall event (legend mechanic)

onFlip.notes: fires on the OnFlip event (legend flip)

onDefeated.notes: fires on the OnDefeated event for this card

abilities.notes: triggered or spend_activated abilities listening to other events

playCostModifier.notes: Reduces this card's own play cost. cost.js effectivePlayCost evaluates `discount` (clamped at 0) and floors the result at `min` (default 1). Optional `condition` gates the WHOLE modifier — when it evaluates false the card costs its printed price, with neither the discount nor the floor applied (We Gotta Live Together: 3 €$ only while a Rival controls 2+ more Gigs). Pure — read wherever a cost is quoted, not just at play-commit. Distinct from the DiscountNextPlay action, which is a one-shot board-level discount on the NEXT matching play.

quick.notes: marks a Program as {Quick} — castable as a reaction during a unit's attack (both the attacker_interrupt and defensive windows), paid at its NORMAL cost out of ready eddies/legends. Engine path: combat.js attWaiting/defWaiting surface eligible hand cards as `interrupt_castable_iids`; player responds with step `play_card_interrupt_cast` (iid only — no extra unit spend). Same `onPlay` runs whether played normally or quick; any legend tapped for the cost fires OnSpent first. (Distinct from the ability-level `quick` flag, which marks a spend_activated ability as a defender reaction.)

ability_spec._comment: Shape of one entry inside the `abilities` array.

quick.notes: spend_activated only ({Quick}). The ability keeps its normal window AND is additionally offered to the DEFENDER as a reaction during a rival unit's attack (the OnCardAttacks window). Paid out of turn at its normal cost. Attacker is not offered it (not reacting to a rival). Resolves in the defensive step, before fight/steal.

condition.notes: gates the trigger after match (eval.js evalCondition)

cost.notes: spend_activated only. `spend.from_self` taps the source; `eddies` pays N €$ from ready eddies/legends (excluding the source). Each card spent to pay (source + any tapped legend) fires OnSpent. Affordability is checked before the ability is offered.

prompt.notes: shown to user when offering the optional spend

actions.name: Optional

otherwise.notes: runs on decline instead of nothing, when present

reveal_from.notes: name of a prior reveal binding; its cards are attached as choice_needed.context.revealed_refs so both players see them (via the reveal banner) while the chooser decides

actions.notes: Halts to ask yes/no (chooser: controller by default, or opponent). On accept, body is prepended to the queue. On decline, otherwise is prepended if present, else nothing happens. no_repush=true.

actions.name: ChooseAmount
actions.notes: Pure prompt; resume writes the chosen number into ctx.bindings[bind_to]. no_repush=true.

actions.name: ChooseCardType
actions.notes: Prompts the chooser to pick a card type (Unit/Gear/Program); resume writes the chosen type STRING into ctx.bindings[bind_to]. Compare it via a type_eq filter referencing {op:'binding'} (Misty Olszewski). no_repush=true.

actions.name: If
actions.notes: Evaluates cond; queues the chosen branch.

actions.name: AddBadge

trigger.notes: same shape as a triggered ability's trigger (event/by/card); by:'controller' means the owner's own unit

condition.notes: extra gate evaluated against the event ctx, e.g. Compare event_field 'margin' >= 3

effect.notes: runs when the badge fires, in a ctx whose self_pid is the badge owner

actions.notes: Registers a board-level delayed trigger ('the next time X this turn, do Y') onto b.badges. The event system scans badges as extra listeners; a matching one fires its effect once and is consumed. Each play adds its own instance (copies stack; both players may hold them). Turn-scoped — clearTransients wipes unfired badges at end of turn. self_iid is null inside the effect (no in-play source); use ctx.source_* for the triggering unit.

actions.name: Draw

side.notes: whose deck to draw from; 'opponent' makes the RIVAL draw (Shattered Memories)

actions.notes: Draws n cards for the firing controller (ctx.self_pid).

actions.name: Discard

target.notes: if omitted, discards top n of own hand (random/auto)

actions.notes: With target: discards the resolved card(s). Without: top-deck-style discard from hand.

actions.name: Mill

bind.notes: if set, the milled refs are bound as an array — feeds 'from among them' picks via filter.in_binding (WNTC-027)

actions.notes: Mills top n from the chosen player's deck.

actions.name: SellTopCard
actions.notes: Sells the top card of the controller's deck: the ref moves to the eddies zone as a ready eddie. Ignores the eddie tag and does NOT touch sold_card_this_turn — an effect sell is allowed on top of the once-per-turn hand sell. Empty deck is a silent no-op.

actions.name: RecoverFromTrash
actions.notes: Moves the chosen trash card back to the owner's hand.

actions.name: SelectTarget
actions.notes: Pure target-pick that only writes the binding; no other side effect. Used to pre-bind a Gig before SearchTopN, etc.

actions.name: SearchTopN

auto_take_all.notes: skip the choice halt and take every filter-matching ref. Legacy path; prefer RevealTop + TakeFromBound for new cards.

actions.halts: yes unless auto_take_all is true and at least one match exists
actions.notes: MEGA-ACTION. Splices top n off deck before halt. Resume picks: kept→hand, rest→deck-bottom-random or trash. no_repush=true. Records to b._reveals.

actions.name: RevealTop

bind.notes: binding name the array of revealed refs is stored under

actions.notes: Peeks the top n of own deck and binds the refs to a name for a later effect (typically TakeFromBound). Does NOT push to b._reveals — that's the resolver's job, so the log line reports both 'revealed' and 'picked' in one row.

actions.name: AckReveal

from.notes: binding holding the revealed ref(s) — a single ref or an array (e.g. from RevealTop)

actions.notes: Halts to SHOW the already-bound revealed card(s) to the controller with an OK button (an acknowledgement, not a pick). No state change on resume; routing runs in the following effects. No-op (continues) if the binding is empty (e.g. empty deck). Use after RevealTop when the player must actually see the card, not just read a log line (Misty Olszewski).

actions.name: TakeFromBound

from.notes: name of a previously-bound array (e.g. from RevealTop)

filter.notes: applied to the bound refs; matches go to hand (ignored when take_none is set)

take_none.notes: true=keep nothing for hand; every bound ref goes to the remainder (trash/deck) regardless of filter

to_top.notes: return the un-taken remainder to the TOP of the deck in order instead of shuffling it to the bottom (Tetratronic Rippler)

actions.notes: Divvies a previously-bound array into hand (matches) and trash/deck-bottom (non-matches). Pushes ONE entry to b._reveals with full revealed+picked sets. Clears the binding when done.

actions.name: ScryTrash

n.notes: how many top cards to look at

min_take.notes: minimum the player MUST trash (capped by trash_up_to and eligible count); makes the trash mandatory (River Ward: trash 1)

filter.notes: which of the revealed cards may be trashed

actions.notes: Look at the top n of own deck; player trashes up to trash_up_to of them; the rest return to the TOP in original order (River Ward). Reuses choose_from_top_n with scry_trash=true — selected go to trash, not hand. no_repush=true.

actions.name: RivalDiscards

bind.notes: binds the LAST discarded card (used by Caliber)

actions.notes: Two-phase: prompts opponent to pick a card from hand, then discards. If n>1, re-queues itself with n-1. Uses scratch binding _rd_pick internally.

actions.name: IncreaseGig
actions.notes: Shared handler. Increments gig value, capped at sides. Re-binds the target with the new gig state plus prev_value (value before the change) so downstream conditions can express 'became X' (Jackie BOX-005).

actions.name: DecreaseGig
actions.notes: Shared handler. May fire OnGigValueChanged (rival-decreases path tracked via ctx._post_gig_decreased).

actions.name: AdjustGig
actions.notes: Shared handler. Combines Increase/Decrease with a signed amount.

actions.name: SetGigValue
actions.notes: Shared handler. Sets exact value (used by Ruthless Lowlife: stolen gigs become 1).

actions.name: TransferGig
actions.notes: Steal a gig — moves it from its current owner to the named recipient (Gorilla Arms). A cross-player transfer fires OnStealGigs (source = the firing gear's host, else the firing card; source_pid = the recipient), so victim/thief listeners react. Cascade note: rate-limit any OnStealGigs trigger that itself transfers gigs.

actions.name: SwapGig

a.notes: type='Gig' — typically from_binding set by a prior SelectTarget

b.notes: type='Gig' on the opposite side of a

actions.notes: Exchange two gigs across sides (Hanako WNTC-072). A swap is an exchange, NOT a steal — no OnStealGigs. The non-acting side sees its row change: OnGigValueChanged fires for it with old_value = the value its row lost, new_value = the value it gained (Meredith's 'adjusts or swaps'). Equal-value swaps fire nothing. Gigs on the same side, or a==b: trace-and-skip.

actions.name: RerollGig
actions.notes: Rerolls the OnGigRolled die in place (located via ctx.event_data.gig_iid/gig_pid). Uses a distinct RNG tag so the new value differs from the original roll, and syncs event_data.value so a later IsMinOrMax sees the post-reroll value. Only meaningful inside an OnGigRolled handler (Kerry's reroll, wrapped in Optional).

actions.name: Defeat

target.notes: type='Unit'; supports quantifier='all' for Adam Smasher

actions.notes: Defeats the resolved unit(s). Pushes to ctx._post_defeats, which drives a follow-up OnDefeated event.

actions.name: DefeatGear
actions.notes: Defeats the resolved gear piece(s).

actions.name: ReturnToHand
actions.notes: Returns the unit(s) to their owner's hand.

actions.name: BottomDeckFromField
actions.notes: Moves the resolved unit(s) from field to the bottom of their owner's deck (Placide, Les Élémens). Array-aware, so quantifier='all' bottom-decks every match.

actions.name: RemoveFromGame
actions.notes: Sends the card to the removed-from-game zone; equipped gear goes with it. Currently unused by shipped scripts.

actions.name: Spend
actions.notes: Marks the resolved card spent.

actions.name: Ready
actions.notes: Marks the resolved card(s) ready — units or legends; supports quantifier='all' to ready every match (Panam end-of-turn).

actions.name: SpendSelf
actions.notes: Convenience: spend the firing card itself.

actions.name: PayEddies

bind.notes: set to true on success; read it with BindingSet to gate 'if you do' clauses

actions.notes: Spends n €$ from the controller's ready eddies/legends mid-effect, firing OnSpent for each card spent. Unaffordable is a silent no-op (the binding stays unset) — gate the offer with the eddie_pool expr rather than relying on the failure. Used by replacement effects that charge a cost outside the normal ability-cost path (Jackie Welles — Mama's Favorite).

actions.name: PreventPendingSteal
actions.notes: Cancels the single gig currently open in the OnWouldStealGig window. Only meaningful inside an OnWouldStealGig handler; a no-op anywhere else. Each chosen gig gets its own window, so cancelling one leaves the rest of a multi-gig steal intact (Alt Cunningham — Mother of Daemons).

actions.name: PreventPendingDefeat
actions.notes: Cancels the defeat currently open in the OnWouldBeDefeated window by marking the top of b._pending_defeats. Only meaningful inside an OnWouldBeDefeated handler; a no-op anywhere else. The engine splits every defeat into _MaybeDefeat -> OnWouldBeDefeated -> _CommitDefeat, so this works for fight defeats, the Defeat action, and end-of-turn scheduled defeats alike.

actions.name: ReadyEddie
actions.notes: Readies up to n of the controller's spent Eddies (Evelyn Parker). Eddies are fungible resources, so no target pick.

actions.name: GrantTempPower

when.notes: gates the bonus per power read instead of applying it flat — e.g. when:{during_fight:true, vs_type:'Unit'} for 'while fighting rival Units' (Synapse Burnout). Stored in _temp_power_when and evaluated by applyStaticPower via _matchWhen.

actions.notes: Adds amount to the target's _temp_power until cleanup. `amount` is evaluated once, at grant time; `when` is re-evaluated on every power read.

actions.name: GrantTempKeyword

keyword.notes: free-form; engine recognized: BLOCKER, CANNOT_ATTACK, CANNOT_READY, NO_HASTE, GO_SOLO, ADRENALINE, UNBLOCKABLE, HASTE_VS_SPENT, HASTE_VS_GIGS, ATTACK_READY_BLOCKERS, ATTACK_READY_UNITS (one-shot: consumed by the next attack declaration), FIGHT_IMMUNE (cannot be defeated in a fight; read at _FightInit), CANNOT_ATTACK_GIGS

until.notes: 'controller_next_turn' (expands to {pid: controller, turn: turn_number+2}) or an explicit {pid, turn}. Without it the keyword lands in _temp_keywords and is wiped at end of turn; WITH it the grant goes to _until_keywords, survives the untap sweep, and is cleared by clearExpiredUntilKeywords on that player's turn. Chrome Reverie, Pacifica Netrunner.

actions.notes: Adds keyword to the target's _temp_keywords until cleanup.

actions.name: ModifyStealCount
actions.notes: Adds amount to the target unit's _steal_mod; runSteal uses n = max(0, 1+floor(pw/10)+mod); cleared end of turn. Take Control: 'a rival Unit steals 1 fewer Gig this turn'.

actions.name: PreventFightDefeat
actions.notes: One-shot fight shield (Reboot Optics: 'the next time a rival Unit fights this turn, it doesn't defeat the opposing friendly Unit'). Sets b._fight_shield[controller]; the next unit-vs-unit fight consumes it and skips the defeat of the controller's unit (the rival's defeat still resolves; OnWinFight unaffected). Cleared at end of turn by clearTransients.

actions.name: DiscountNextPlay

filter.notes: which card the discount applies to (e.g. {type:'Program'}); null = any

actions.notes: Registers a one-shot board-level play discount (b._next_play_discount) consumed by the controller's next matching play this turn; cleared at end of turn. Applied by cost.js effectivePlayCost (pure) and consumed at play-commit — covers play_card, quick interrupt casts, and PlayFromZone with pay_cost (Alt Cunningham: next Program plays for -1 €$ per friendly min Gig).

actions.name: Equip

source.notes: the gear to equip; may have zone='hand' or equipped_to:{from_self:true}

actions.notes: Source uses TargetSpec instead of `target`. Removes gear from its current location (hand or current host) and equips to dest. Dest auto-binds 'host'.

actions.name: ScheduleDefeat

condition.notes: optional; re-evaluated at end of turn against the scheduled unit (self = that unit). If it fails (or the unit is gone), the defeat is skipped. Used by Cyberpsychosis with SelfDidCombat.

actions.notes: Schedules a defeat at end of turn (Reboot Optics, Cyberpsychosis). Drives endTurnCleanup. With `condition`, the defeat is conditional.

actions.name: MarkPeeked
actions.notes: Sets _peeked=true on the legend (Kiroshi Optics — look without revealing).

actions.name: CompelAttack
actions.notes: Marks the target Unit (u._must_attack_on = next turn number) so it must attack on its controller's next turn if able (Evelyn Parker). endTurn refuses to end while a marked unit can still legally attack (canUnitAttack); declareAttack clears the marker; clearTransients clears it once that turn ends. mainWaiting surfaces compelled units as must_attack_iids.

actions.name: PlayFromZone

target.notes: the card to play; source zone defaults to 'trash'

to.notes: where the card goes after it resolves; 'deck' = bottom of the controller's deck

pay_cost.notes: if true, spend the card's EFFECTIVE cost (playCostModifier + any pending next-play discount) from the controller's ready eddies/legends first; if unaffordable the play is skipped

actions.notes: Plays the target card from its zone (Alt Cunningham): splices it out, optionally pays its cost, queues OnPlay + OnCardPlayed sub-events, then places it in `to`. Without pay_cost the play is free (old Alt). When to='field' and the card is a Unit it is instantiated as a real unit (state:'ready', entered_play_turn) and placed BEFORE its OnPlay fires, matching the normal play_card order (Yorinobu Arasaka — Steel Dragon).

actions.name: PlayGearFromZone

target.notes: the Gear to play; target.zone picks the source zone — default 'hand' (River Ward), 'trash' plays from trash (Viktor Vektor — You Might Feel a Little Pinch)

dest.notes: the host to equip it to; defaults to a friendly Unit, chooser=controller; filter.exclude_self restricts to 'another' Unit

actions.halts: yes if either pick has chooser=controller and >1 candidate
actions.notes: Plays a Gear for free WITH equip (River Ward): picks the gear, picks a host, splices the gear from target.zone, equips it, then fires OnPlay + OnCardPlayed. If the host pick comes up empty the gear stays where it is. PlayFromZone does not equip — use this for gears.

actions.name: CallLegend

target.notes: defaults to a face_down friendly Legend, chooser=controller, optional

actions.notes: Flips a face-down Legend face-up for free (Chrome Reverie). No-op if a legend was already called this turn or the target is already face-up. Sets called_legend_this_turn and queues OnCall + OnFlip.

actions.name: BindValue
actions.notes: Evaluates an expression NOW and stores the number in a binding, so a later condition can compare against a value captured before the board changed (Shattered Memories counts both hands before discarding them).

actions.name: RestrictGigSteals

forbid.notes: 'above_power': raiders may only take Gigs valued <= their power (Chrome Fang). 'below_power': only Gigs valued >= their power (Westbrook Netrunner).

attacker.notes: scopes which raiders are limited, matched against the attacker's card def — so {type:'Unit'} excludes GO_SOLO'd Legends and {type:'Legend'} catches them (card-def type convention, same as trigger.card). null = every raider.

actions.notes: Board-level: while active, a rival raider stealing from this controller's Gig row only sees Gigs passing the power test. Entries stack (a Unit-scoped and a Legend-scoped entry can coexist); re-casting the same shape refreshes its duration. Stored on b._steal_power_limits, read by combat.js runSteal, expired by primitives.js clearExpiredUntilKeywords (Chrome Fang, Westbrook Netrunner).

actions.name: DiscountGoSolo

target.notes: type='Legend', face_up (GO SOLO requires face-up + ready); pair with filter {has_keyword:'GO_SOLO'} so the prompt never offers a legend that cannot solo

actions.notes: Turn-scoped, per-legend GO SOLO discount (Nocturne OP55 N1: a friendly Legend solos for -2 €$, min 1). Sets legend._solo_discount, applied by events.js goSoloCost AFTER SoloCostTax with its own floor, surfaced to the client as legend.solo_cost, wiped by clearTransients at end of turn.

conditions.name: True
conditions.notes: always true

conditions.name: False
conditions.notes: always false

ref.notes: binding name pointing to a gig

conditions.name: IsMinOrMax
conditions.notes: True when value is the die's min (1) or max (== sides). Pairs with OnGigRolled (value/sides via event_field) for Kerry's min/max draw.

conditions.name: GigValueExists
conditions.notes: true if any of side's gigs equals the evaluated value

conditions.name: HasSidedPair
conditions.notes: true if two of side's gigs share the same number of sides

conditions.name: HasValuePair
conditions.notes: true if two of side's gigs share the same value

conditions.name: DistinctGigValueCount
conditions.notes: compares the count of distinct gig values on a side to value (Zetatech Faceplate draw clause)

conditions.name: HasInZone
conditions.notes: true if any card in the named zone matches the filter

conditions.name: HasInZoneN
conditions.notes: true if at least n matches

conditions.name: CanCallLegend
conditions.notes: true if the controller has not called a legend this turn AND has a face-down legend. Gates free-call prompts (Chrome Reverie) so the engine never offers a CallLegend that would no-op.

conditions.name: SelfIsReady
conditions.notes: the firing card is in 'ready' state

conditions.name: SelfIsSpent
conditions.notes: the firing card is in 'spent' state

conditions.name: SelfDidCombat
conditions.notes: this unit stole or fought this turn (set in combat resolution, cleared at end-of-turn cleanup). Intended for ScheduleDefeat.condition (Cyberpsychosis).

conditions.name: SelfStoleGig
conditions.notes: this unit stole at least one Gig this turn via the combat steal path (handleStealChoice sets _stole_gig_this_turn; cleared at end-of-turn cleanup). Steal-specific — fights do NOT set it. Delamain Cab: 'at the end of your turn, if this Unit stole a Gig this turn, ready 1 Eddie' (OnEndTurn by:controller + this condition).

conditions.name: PlayedProgramThisTurn
conditions.notes: true if the side's player has played a Program this turn — main-phase play, quick interrupt cast, or PlayFromZone (set at play-commit in playProgram / PlayFromZone; cleared at end-of-turn cleanup). Jacked-In Voodoo Boy: conditional CANNOT_ATTACK via Not(PlayedProgramThisTurn).

conditions.name: SelfEquipsSource
conditions.notes: self (a gear) is equipped on the event source unit

conditions.name: HostEquipsSelf
conditions.notes: self has at least one equipped gear

conditions.name: HostNamed
conditions.notes: for gear: true if its equipped host has the given lead name (part before ' — ', accent/case-insensitive). Dying Night — V's Pistol: ready 2 Eddies at end of turn if its host is named 'V'.

conditions.name: BoundMatches
conditions.notes: true if the card bound under `ref` matches `filter` (card-def match via matchCard; supports any_of/subtype_has/type/etc.). Take Control: draw if the chosen Unit is AI/Drone/Vehicle.

conditions.name: BindingSet
conditions.notes: true if ctx.bindings[name] is set and non-null — common pattern for 'if you did the optional thing'. A declined optional target pick writes a null binding, which reads as NOT set.

expression_ops.notes: or pass a bare number — handled directly
args[0] % args[1]; 0 if the divisor is 0 (never throws). Street-cred parity: mod(street_cred, 2) == 0 (Field Operator).
reads from ctx.bindings; returns 0 if non-numeric

reads the RAW value of ctx.bindings[name] (string/object/etc, null if unset) — unlike 'ref' it does NOT coerce to a number. Used to compare a chosen card-type string in a type_eq filter (Misty Olszewski).
shortcut for ref to a bound gig's value
array of a side's gig values — feeds membership filters cost_in / value_not_in (Hanako, Gorilla Arms)
count of that side's READY eddies + ready legends — the pool PayEddies draws from. Gate an optional payment with Compare(eddie_pool >= n) so the prompt is never offered unaffordably.

from_source.notes: read the EVENT SOURCE's gear instead (ctx.source_iid) — lets a triggered ability gate on 'a friendly equipped Unit or Legend' (Alt Cunningham — Mother of Daemons)

expression_ops.notes: reads from ctx.event_data — used by triggered abilities to inspect the event payload
number of value-pairs among side's gigs (Sandayu Oda, Goro Vengeful)
effective power of the firing card (base + temp + gear + statics/auras, floored at 0); 0 if it isn't on the board. Compose with Compare for 'this Unit has power N+' (Swordwise Huscle).

ref.notes: binding name of a card ref; reads cost from DB by card_id. Use after SelectTarget from hand.

expression_ops.notes: Returns the cost of a bound card ref (e.g. the card chosen to discard). If the binding is an array (e.g. from RevealTop), reads the first element (Sasha Yakovleva).

effective power of the EVENT SOURCE (ctx.source_*), the mirror of self_power. 0 if the source is not on the board. Lets a listener compare against the power of the unit that fired the event (Rogue Amendiares — Queen of the Afterlife).

trigger_spec._comment: Shape of the `trigger` field on an Ability. Matched by eval.js matchTrigger.

by.notes: self=event source is this card; controller=source belongs to my controller; opponent=source belongs to the rival; host=self is gear and source is its bearer

card.notes: filters the source card (e.g. by faction, color)

rate_limit_scope.notes: what the 'first' is scoped by. controller scope is keyed per card_id, so two different cards with controller-scoped limits on the same event don't suppress each other (copies of the same card still share it)

trigger_events.name: OnPlay
trigger_events.notes: fired when a card enters play (units/gears) or resolves (programs)

trigger_events.name: OnDefeated
trigger_events.notes: fired after a unit is defeated; event_data.gear_count = how much gear it had (River Ward reacts to a friendly EQUIPPED unit dying)

trigger_events.name: OnSpent
trigger_events.notes: fired when a card becomes spent — attacking, paying a spend cost, or a Spend/SpendSelf effect. by:'host' lets equipped gear react (Zetatech Faceplate)

trigger_events.name: OnCardAttacks
trigger_events.notes: an attacking unit declared its attack

trigger_events.name: OnBlock
trigger_events.notes: a Unit was declared as a blocker (redirecting a rival attack to itself). source = the blocking unit; use by:'controller' to react to a friendly Unit blocking (Goro Takemura — Vengeful Bodyguard)

trigger_events.name: OnGigValueChanged
trigger_events.notes: fires when a player changes the value of a gig they don't own (any direction — increase/decrease/set). Meredith Stout reacts to a Rival adjusting/swapping her friendly Gigs

trigger_events.name: OnStealGigs
trigger_events.notes: fires ONCE after a steal resolves, over the gigs that actually moved (a gig cancelled in its OnWouldStealGig window is absent). exposed via from_event: 'stolen_gigs' or event_field expr

trigger_events.name: OnWouldStealGig
trigger_events.notes: replacement window opened once PER CHOSEN GIG, while that gig is still in the victim's row and before any of them move. source_* is the attacking unit, so the victim listens with by:'opponent'. A listener calls PreventPendingSteal to stop that one gig. event_data.gig is a one-element array for from_event targeting; value/sides are the die's face and size (Alt Cunningham — Mother of Daemons).

trigger_events.name: OnLoseFight
trigger_events.notes: fires for the LOSER of a unit-vs-unit fight — attacker or defender — while it is still on the field, immediately before its defeat is committed. event_data.opposing is a one-element array holding the other fighter, so target it with from_event:'opposing' rather than re-deriving it (Maelstrom Zealots). Does not fire when the loser's defeat was already prevented by a fight shield.

trigger_events.name: OnWouldBeDefeated
trigger_events.notes: replacement window opened by _MaybeDefeat before EVERY defeat commits — fight, the Defeat action, and end-of-turn scheduled defeats. source_* is the unit about to die, still on the field. A listener calls PreventPendingDefeat to cancel it (Jackie Welles — Mama's Favorite). Fires even with no listeners; the scan is a no-op then.

trigger_events.name: OnWinFight
trigger_events.notes: fires for the surviving winner of a unit-vs-unit fight — attacker OR a friendly blocker that beats the attacker. event_field 'margin' = winner_power - loser_power (for 'wins by N+' gates). Consumers: Satori (by:host draw), badge steal.

trigger_events.name: OnEndTurn
trigger_events.notes: fired at the end of the active player's turn, before scheduled cleanup. source_pid = active player; use by:'controller' so a unit fires on its own controller's turn (e.g. 'at end of your turn, return this Unit to hand')

trigger_events.name: OnPlayPhaseStart
trigger_events.notes: fired at the start of the active player's main phase

trigger_events.name: OnGigRolled
trigger_events.notes: fires when the active player rolls a Gig from their fixer area (start-of-turn), after the die is pushed to gigs. source_pid = the roller; use by:'controller'. Adjusting/stealing a gig is NOT a roll and does not fire this. Kerry Eurodyne — Axe, Attitude, Audience: optional reroll (RerollGig) + min/max draw (IsMinOrMax)

keyword.notes: uppercased on read; engine-recognized: GO_SOLO, ADRENALINE, BLOCKER, CANNOT_ATTACK, UNBLOCKABLE, HASTE_VS_SPENT, HASTE_VS_GIGS, ATTACK_READY_BLOCKERS, ATTACK_READY_UNITS, FIGHT_IMMUNE, CANNOT_ATTACK_GIGS

static_kinds.notes: Adds the keyword to this card while condition holds.
Adds expr to this unit's power while when holds.
Multiplies effective power. Currently unused by shipped scripts (El Sombrerón uses GrantTempPower).
Adds expr to power of every card matching affects.
Grants keyword to every card matching affects (e.g. gear granting BLOCKER to its host via affects:{is:'equipped_host'}).

vs.notes: matched against the OPPOSING fighter's card definition; omit to auto-win every fight

static_kinds.notes: This unit wins any unit-vs-unit fight matching `vs` regardless of power — the other fighter is defeated, this one is not, and OnWinFight fires for this one (Johnny Silverhand — Never Stop Fighting, vs faction 'Corpo'). Read by events.js alwaysWinsFight, snapshotted in _FightInit. If BOTH fighters auto-win, the normal power compare decides. Fight shields still apply on top.

side.notes: whose GO SOLO is taxed, seen from this card's controller

static_kinds.notes: Raises the €$ cost of playing a Legend via GO SOLO (Riot Shield: rivals pay +2). Read by events.js goSoloCost — charged in turn.js play_legend_solo and surfaced to the client as legend.solo_cost by server/lib/rooms.js.

amount.notes: €$ off this controller's legend call; the base call cost is 1, floored at 0

static_kinds.notes: Lowers the €$ cost of the controller's main-phase Call (Panam Palmer — Strength Through Family: amount 1 makes it free). Read by events.js legendCallCost — charged in turn.js call_legend. Only friendly in-play sources count; the defensive call is unaffected.

when_spec._comment: Modifier gating used on Static expressions (events.js _matchWhen).

vs_type.notes: only set during a unit-vs-unit fight: the card type of the opposing fighter. Meredith Stout: +2 power while fighting a Legend

affects_spec._comment: Used by Aura/AuraKeyword to pick the cards an aura modifies.

is.notes: special: matches the unit/legend wearing this gear

exclude_self.notes: drop the source card itself from the aura ('Other friendly Units' — Saul Bright)

target_spec._comment: TargetSpec — the universal way to point at one or more game entities. Resolved by select.js resolveTarget + selectTarget. Multiple resolution paths; first matching wins.

from_binding.notes: re-use a previously written binding by name

from_host.notes: for gear: the unit/legend it's equipped to

from_trigger_source.notes: the card that fired the current event (ctx.source_*)

side.notes: engine treats anything other than 'opponent' as own; 'both' iterates both players

zone.notes: defaults from type: Gig→gigs, Unit→field, Legend→legends, Gear→equipped. Special virtual zone 'in_play' = field units + face-up legends (gear equip dests, e.g. River Ward)

equipped_to.notes: for gear: only show pieces equipped on a specific host

optional.notes: if pool is empty, skip silently instead of failing

bind.notes: if set, the resolved value is stored in ctx.bindings[bind]

target_spec.notes: Auto-pick fires even when chooser=controller if the pool has exactly one element — logged to b._auto_picks.

filter_spec._comment: Filter applied to candidate cards inside a TargetSpec or condition. Implemented by primitives.js matchFilter.

exclude_self.notes: skips the firing card itself (Adam Smasher)

exclude_binding.notes: skips the card currently bound under this name (Peace Offering: dst gig ≠ src gig)

opposite_side_of.notes: only refs whose _pid differs from the ref bound under this name — "another player's Gig" (Padre — Man of the Cross)

in_binding.notes: only cards in the array bound under this name (by iid) — pairs with Mill.bind for 'from among them' picks (WNTC-027)

type_not.notes: card type ≠ this. Currently unused by shipped scripts

type_eq.notes: card type === this; Expr is evaluated (use {op:'binding'} to match a player-chosen type — Misty Olszewski)

cost_lte.notes: Expr is evaluated — supports card_cost op (WNTC-093)

cost_in.notes: card cost ∈ the array; Expr may resolve to an array (e.g. gig_values). Hanako: cost equal to any friendly Gig value

power_lte.notes: EFFECTIVE power (statics/gear/temp) for refs on the board; printed power for hand/deck/trash refs; Expr evaluated (Over the Edge: power ≤ a friendly d20's value)

power_gte.notes: effective power on board, printed off board

power_eq.notes: effective power on board, printed off board; Expr evaluated (Wraith Marauders: power equal to a stolen Gig's value)

faction.notes: matches if card subtype contains this token

subtype_has.notes: matches if subtype list contains this token (e.g. 'Braindance')

value.notes: for Gig: matches the rolled face. Array means any-of; expr is evaluated; expr may resolve to a scalar OR array

value_not_in.notes: for Gig: value ∉ the array; Expr may resolve to an array (e.g. gig_values). Gorilla Arms: value not shared by a friendly Gig

value_parity.notes: for Gig: value is even / odd (WNTC-066)

value_eq_sides.notes: for Gig: at max value (value === sides)

sides.notes: for Gig: matches die size (Gorilla Arms)

power_lt_friendly_max.notes: for Unit: effective power < the highest effective power among friendly field units (Carnage)

power_is_lowest.notes: for Unit: effective power is the minimum among the field units on that ref's OWN side — side-relative, so it works on a rival pool. Leaves every tied-lowest unit in the pool so the chooser picks among them (Les Élémens)

any_of.notes: logical OR of sub-filters (evaluated by matchCard)

has_keyword.notes: matches if the card's SCRIPT declares a SelfKeyword with this name (case-insensitive). The cards.json `keywords` column is null for every card, so this reads the script, not the data (Arasaka Emergency Radioport: '... or has {Go Solo}').

card_filter_spec._comment: Filter applied to event source cards in TriggerSpec.card. Subset of FilterSpec — operates on the card definition (db), not a board ref. Implemented by eval.js _matchCardFilter.

choice_kinds.notes: Two-zone pick: Programs in hand or trash (Lizzy Wizzy). Client matches via isChoosable expansion.
Pick a card type (Unit/Gear/Program); writes the chosen type string to a binding (Misty Olszewski).
Shows the revealed card(s) with an OK button; no pick (Misty Olszewski).

context_lifecycle._comment: Variables available on ctx and how they flow.
context_lifecycle.self_pid: the player controlling the firing card
context_lifecycle.source_pid: the player whose action caused the event
context_lifecycle.source_iid: the iid of the event source card
context_lifecycle.source_card_id: the card_id of the event source card
context_lifecycle.event_data: event payload object — read via from_event or event_field
context_lifecycle.bindings: key→value store; written by target.bind, ChooseAmount.bind_to, RivalDiscards.bind, trigger context; read via from_binding, ref expr, BindingSet condition
context_lifecycle.active_player: set by callers; consulted by when.active_player
context_lifecycle.during_fight: set during fight resolution; consulted by when.during_fight
context_lifecycle._post_defeats: queue of defeats that need to fire OnDefeated after the chain settles
context_lifecycle._post_gig_changed: queue of rival-caused gig value changes to fire OnGigValueChanged
context_lifecycle._post_spends: queue of spends that need to fire OnSpent after the chain settles
